title: Shared Blind Spots Defeat Ensemble Monitoring: Measuring Correlated Misses Across a 'Diverse' Monitor Panel

original_idea.body:
# Shared Blind Spots Defeat Ensemble Monitoring: Measuring Correlated Misses Across a 'Diverse' Monitor Panel

**Problem:** Oversight via LLM ensembles assumes monitors fail independently; if monitors share blind spots, the ensemble fails exactly when it matters.

**Direction:** Build a monitoring task using 6 open models as monitors. Inject unsafe outputs. Measure whether misses are independent or correlated (shared misses exceeding chance). Compute focal-diversity / correlated-error rate.

**Why it matters:** Defense-in-depth via 'use multiple models to watch each other' is a core safety proposal; this quantifies how homogeneity erodes its safety margin.

**Relevant context:** Artificial Hivemind; Correlated Errors (arXiv 2506.07962); LLM-TOPLA focal diversity.
